parts.name: Root
parts.description: The `<nav>` landmark, named "Breadcrumb" in the locale of `LocaleProvider`.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the element.

props.name: aria-label
props.description:
The name of the landmark. Without it, the name is "Breadcrumb" in the locale of
`LocaleProvider`. Give one when the page has two sets of breadcrumbs.

props.name: element
props.description: The `<nav>` element. Use `bind:element` to read it.

parts.name: List
parts.description: The `<ol>` of the trail, with `role="list"` in writing. The order of the items is the order of the pages.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the element.

props.name: element
props.description: The `<ol>` element. Use `bind:element` to read it.

parts.name: Item
parts.description: One page of the trail, as an `<li>`. It holds a link, and a separator after the link on every item but the last.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the element.

props.name: element
props.description: The `<li>` element. Use `bind:element` to read it.

parts.name: Link
parts.description: The page, as an `<a>` with an `href`, or a `<span>` without one. `current` marks the page the user is on.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the element.

props.name: href
props.description: The address of the page. Without it, the link is plain text.

props.name: current
props.description:
Marks the page the user is on. The link gets `aria-current="page"`. Set it on the last
item: a screen reader user then knows where the trail ends.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Takes the link out of use: it keeps its text, and it loses its `href` and its tab stop.

props.name: element
props.description: The `<a>` element, or the `<span>` without an `href`. Use `bind:element` to read it.

dataAttributes.name: data-current
dataAttributes.description: Present on the link of the page the user is on.

parts.name: Separator
parts.description: The sign between two pages, hidden from the screen reader. A slash without children.

props.name: children
props.description: The sign between two items. A slash without children.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the element.

props.name: element
props.description: The `<span>` element. Use `bind:element` to read it.
